title: The Immersive Edge: June 2026 industry content wrap-up
summary: Explore Unity’s June 2026 industry content wrap-up, with resources on Unity Studio, CAD automation, industrial AI, digital twins, and customer stories.
body_markdown:
## **3D innovation: helping more teams create with Unity Studio**


[Unity Studio](https://unity.com/products/unity-studio) is a web-based editor that helps teams create, collaborate on, and share interactive 3D experiences - without coding complexity. This section gathers everything we published to help you get started and how teams use it.


### **The making of Unity Studio**


Learn[how Unity Studio was created](https://unity.com/blog/making-unity-studio) . This piece explores the vision behind building an accessible entry point to real-time 3D, and the problems it solves for non-technical teams.


### **New collaboration and export tools in Unity Studio**


Unity Studio[supports annotations and Unity Studio-to-Editor export](https://unity.com/blog/unity-studio-collaboration-editor-export) , which helps teams review work together and scale projects into production. Learn how these features turn 3D from a solo task into a shared workflow.


### **Unity Studio web-based editor livestream (on-demand)**


Missed the live session? Watch our[on-demand walkthrough](https://unity.com/resources/unity-studio-livestream-on-demand) of the Unity Studio editor, including a live 10-minute build. Learn how to import 3D data, assemble an interactive scene, and share it with a web link.


### **Top Unity Studio questions answered**


New to Unity Studio?[This Q&A blog](https://unity.com/blog/unity-studio-questions-answered-build-3d-without-complexity) answers common questions from teams getting started, from supported file formats to how Unity Studio fits alongside the Unity Editor.


### **A day in the life: a training designer builds 3D without developers**


Follow a fictional training designer as they[build an interactive 3D learning experience from scratch](https://unity.com/blog/interactive-3d-training-unity-studio-without-simulation-teams) , without writing a single line of code. See how Unity Studio helps L&D teams create and update their own training content.


### **A day in the life: solutions engineer building interactive product demos**


See how[a solutions engineer can use Unity Studio](https://unity.com/blog/solutions-engineers-guide-interactive-product-demos-unity-studio) to turn static product data into interactive demos that explain products to customers. This story highlights how Unity Studio supports technical sales workflows.


### **The collaboration: from Studio to Editor**


Move from static to interactive and from prototype to production - this article[explains the Studio-to-Editor workflow](https://unity.com/resources/industrial-teams-migrating-web-projects-with-unity-studio-importer) . Learn how domain experts can validate ideas in Unity Studio while developers extend and deploy from the Unity Editor, all from the same project.
